The '''Gormak cannon''' was a massive cannon constructed by the [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in their city of [[Gorma-Koss]] on the orders of their king, [[Jokull]]. The weapon was aimed at the mountaintop city of [[Voss-Ka]], the home of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]]' other native species, the [[Voss (species)|Voss]].
